title: Abakhapheli Babakhethiweyo
intro: Kuwo wonke umlando, izithunywa zaphezulu zazihamba phakathi kwesintu, futhi abanye babantu abaseduze nabo behluleka ukubona ukukhanya. Lokhu kulandisa kugxile emiphefumulweni emibili eseduze kwayo nobuprofethi kwaba isivivinyo sayo, futhi ifa layo laba yisifundo esingapheli.
clues: Sasiphila ezikhathini zabaprofethi abakhulu, kodwa amehlo ethu ahlala evaliwe eqinisweni abalilethayo.
Amakhaya ethu ayegcwele isambulo saphezulu, kodwa izinhliziyo zethu zazilukhuni.
Sasishade namadoda ayekhethwe ukuxwayisa abantu bawo.
Lapho kufika isijeziso, asizange sifune indawo yokukhosela emkhunjini noma sibalekele imvula evuthayo, ngoba sahleka usulu izixwayiso.
Kukhulunywa ngathi kuyiQuran njengesibonelo salabo abangakholwa, okubonisa ukuthi ngisho nobuhlobo obuseduze nomprofethi abusindisi.
Singabafazi bakaNuh noLut, ababakhaphela futhi ngaleyo ndlela balahlwa.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
